nvitk.gui.viz.qc_loader
=======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.viz.qc_loader

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Locate and load QC assets for qvtpy / eicab pipelines into Napari.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.gui.viz.qc_loader.resolve_qvtpy_tree

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: resolve_qvtpy_tree(resource_root: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path

   Return the directory that contains ``qvtpy/`` stage folders.

   Accepts a subject root, a ``qvtpy/`` folder, or an XNAT unpack that still has
   ``…/resources/qvtpy/files/stage*`` nesting.


.. py:function:: resolve_stage6_dir(resource_root: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Locate ``stage6_measure`` under a subject / qvtpy / XNAT download tree.


.. py:function:: resolve_eicab_tree(resource_root: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path

   Locate the ``eicab`` output directory under *resource_root* (direct child, the root itself, or
   found by recursive search); falls back to *resource_root* if nothing matches.


.. py:function:: find_phase_paths(search_roots: list[pathlib.Path]) -> dict[str, pathlib.Path]

   Discover AP/RL/FH phase NIfTIs under download trees.


.. py:function:: find_cd_path(search_roots: list[pathlib.Path]) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Find a 3D complex-difference NIfTI under any of *search_roots*; ``None`` if none is found.


.. py:function:: load_eicab_qc_layers(viewer: Any, resource_root: pathlib.Path, *, tof_search_roots: list[pathlib.Path] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]

   Load TOF + eICAB resampled / CW / WB outputs.


.. py:function:: load_qvtpy_qc_layers(viewer: Any, app_state: dict[str, Any], resource_root: pathlib.Path, *, extra_search_roots: list[pathlib.Path] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]

   Load qvtpy QC layers and auxiliary docks for one subject.


.. py:function:: download_pipeline_resource_for_qc(*, config_path: pathlib.Path, project_id: str, subject_uid: str, resource_label: str, password: str, download_root: pathlib.Path | None = None, app_state: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> pathlib.Path

   Download an XNAT experiment resource into a cache directory.


.. py:function:: download_phase_niftis_for_qc(*, config_path: pathlib.Path, project_id: str, subject_uid: str, password: str, download_root: pathlib.Path, app_state: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> pathlib.Path

   Download 4DFLOW AP/RL/FH scan NIfTIs into ``{root}/{subject}/4DFlow/{AP,RL,FH}``.

   Layout matches :func:`find_phase_paths` so QC loading discovers phases the same
   way as the local NIfTI tree.
